notes.title: 6.20 regular Update - Version 0.4.6
notes.content:
1.Fixed Android version's controller config that may happen before Chapter 3 and used Chapter 3's UI instead of normal.
2.Fixed some un-important DATA bugs.
3.Sprites and Textures update. including Area Forest's double leaves.
4.Area Ruins still in pregress. But there's BGM or somesthing else pre-updated.
5.SaveFile System re-maked. Please backup your savefiles before game playing.
6.Fixed lots of texts mistakes and words in naming time.
7.In-game Menu System re-maked. Now allows use in Boss Area(may have bugs)
8.And....What's else......I forgot...
